what_it_is: 100% Perfect and legit FRENCH save file, no cheats used. All made by myself.
format: Max Drive / PowerSave save: 'Ps2PowerSave' header (CRC32 dc8e987d, matches), folder BESCES-51607RATCHET, 7 files, LZARI stream 55368 bytes unpacking to 479768 bytes (479450 bytes of file data)

title: Ratchet & Clank
save.times: none: a max file stores no file times

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'ratchet-and-clank-going-commando.25213.max' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BESCES-51607RATCHET
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
